append_only: Notes are only ever added. The frozen files and past scored rows are never changed.

notes.note: From the week of 2026-11-16 the weekly score runs on the hosted VPS (arm64, Python 3.12 in the API image) instead of the owner's PC (x86-64), as part of moving every scheduled job to the VPS (Win Probability v4, W7c). Before the move both machines rescored the same 174 finished 2026-27 games (through 2026-11-12) from the same frozen files and the same database contents: the predicted margin and win probability of each of the nine candidates, 3132 values, largest difference 1.1e-16 (registered tolerance 1e-9). The VPS rescore also equals the 1314 values of the 146 rows the PC had already written, exactly. The frozen model, the rules and the past rows are unchanged.
